post.caption: Marco Polo wrote of shark charmers. He wrote that charmers protected pearl divers from sharks. The Gulf of Mannar lies between India and Sri Lanka, and its pearls have been prized for more than 2,000 years. The Roman writer Pliny praised the pearls of Ceylon. The oysters lived on rocky banks called paars, and divers sank with a stone and pinched their noses shut. A helper stayed in the boat for every two divers. The oysters sometimes vanished from the beds for years, and the 1903 fishery was the first since 1891. In 1925, a Sri Lankan ordinance gave the State pearl fishing rights.
